desc: The complete releasable personnel file of Richard C. Doty from his service as a New Mexico State Police officer, 321 pages, obtained under the New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act (NMSA 14-2-1 et seq.) and published in May 2021 after redaction by the New Mexico Department of Public Safety. It is the only substantial documentary record of the post-AFOSI career of the only US counterintelligence officer to admit running UFO disinformation against American civilians. Its significance is corroborative rather than revelatory: it establishes Doty as a real, traceable law-enforcement employee with a documented service history rather than a self-invented figure, which matters because the standard institutional response to the Bennewitz record has been to treat all of its participants as unreliable narrators. State public-records law produced what federal FOIA has never produced on this subject: a complete personnel file.
